dateAudit.dateOnlyClockConvention: No timestamp is invented; date-only bounds also cover unconfirmed source timezones

durationAudit.nonRecordPolicy: Submissions without a documented WR reign have zero credited WR duration; identical player/total WR evidence inherits canonical bounds.
durationAudit.uncertaintyPolicy: Date-only and retrospective evidence produces duration bounds, never an asserted exact reign.

retainedSourceGapPolicy: Known WR review closes with explicit source gaps; unsupported achievement instants, original upload chronology and player aliases are not invented.
finalBoardDatePolicy: Literal named final-board publication supplies a supported reporting date when no earlier independently supported exact named result is selected. Four previously dated worksheet entries retain their earlier reports; Kirio uses the earlier original repost. All36 named worksheet totals match the boards. Original-video lap splits take precedence over differing board splits.
